app_info.subtitle: Create images and videos
app_info.description: FrameForge lets users create cinematic images and video clips from ChatGPT, render scenes in existing FrameForge compositions, and continue working with generated media in the private FrameForge studio.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new generated image and updates credits in the authenticated user's private FrameForge workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the authenticated user's private FrameForge workspace and does not publish content to public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new media and consumes credits but does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly alter existing user content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new generated video and updates credits in the authenticated user's private FrameForge workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the authenticated user's private FrameForge workspace and does not publish content to public internet services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates new media and consumes credits but does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or irreversibly alter existing user content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders a scene for an authenticated user's existing private FrameForge composition and may update that workspace's generation state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Operates within the authenticated user's private FrameForge workspace and does not publish the scene to a public or third-party service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Renders media without deleting content, revoking access, or performing an irreversible external transaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns a link to the authenticated user's FrameForge studio and does not modify workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns a navigation URL without writing to FrameForge, public internet state, or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, spend credits, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.user_prompt: Use FrameForge to create a cinematic storyboard image of a futuristic city at night.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the image in the authenticated FrameForge workspace and returns the generated media with a link to continue in FrameForge.

test_cases.description: Generate a widescreen video with audio disabled.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use FrameForge to make a 6-second 16:9 cinematic video of a spacecraft approaching a red planet, with audio off.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates the requested private video and returns the generated media with a link to continue in FrameForge.

test_cases.description: Render a scene in an existing composition.
test_cases.user_prompt: In FrameForge composition demo-composition, render scene 1 as a rainy neon street at night for 8 seconds.
test_cases.expected_output: Attempts to render the specified scene for the authenticated user's composition and returns the scene result or a clear access/input error.

test_cases.user_prompt: Open FrameForge so I can continue editing my project.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a link to the authenticated user's FrameForge studio without changing workspace data.

test_cases.user_prompt: Use FrameForge to generate a cinematic image called Final Frame of a mountain fortress at sunrise.
test_cases.expected_output: If sufficient credits are available, returns the generated image; otherwise clearly reports insufficient FrameForge credits and links to FrameForge without generating media.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke FrameForge for general factual questions.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of Ghana?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request does not ask to create or access FrameForge media.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke FrameForge for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my team tomorrow at 10 AM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside FrameForge's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke FrameForge merely to explain image-generation concepts.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Explain how diffusion image models work without generating an image.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the user requested an explanation rather than FrameForge media generation.
